result_excerpt:
#4201 Password reset email links to localhost
Opened by mkowalczyk on 2026-09-08

I clicked "Forgot password" on the login page. The email arrived within a
minute, but the link in it goes to

    http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=…

which of course doesn't load for me. Two people on my team

name: read_file

input.body:
label: bug
file: src/notifications/templates.ts

The issue is that the password reset email contains a link that points to http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=..., which is incorrect for users outside the local development environment. This happens because the BASE_URL is set to process.env.PUBLIC_URL or defaults to "http://localhost:3000" if PUBLIC_URL is not defined. To fix this, the configuration for PUBLIC_URL or the way the BASE_URL is set should be reviewed and corrected to use the appropriate production URL.
